ratingReview.headline: SN24 ms.computer records an owner-address change after a coldkey swap
ratingReview.consequence: Four stars: a finalized change to subnet control following a key migration has material consequences for tracking SN24 ownership. Three understates that control change; five is not supported by established broader impact or an independently confirmed incident.
ratingReview.evidence: Finalized swap, owner-change and before-and-after identity evidence
ratingReview.scope: SN24 on-chain control address; registration and project name unchanged.
ratingReview.uncertainty: Beneficial ownership, cause and launch status unresolved.

ratingReview.headline: SN28 SayGM introduces optional guardrails before requests reach providers
ratingReview.consequence: Three stars: a useful, bounded gateway feature for existing users. Four would require evidence of a more consequential service change beyond optional request filtering.
ratingReview.evidence: SayGM November 13 guardrails announcement; SayGM documentation
ratingReview.adjacentRatingReason: Three stars: a useful, bounded gateway feature for existing users. Four would require evidence of a more consequential service change beyond optional request filtering.

ratingReview.headline: SN47 is re-registered after the former GF registration is removed
ratingReview.consequence: Four stars: replacing an active subnet registration is a major lifecycle change affecting identity and market-history interpretation. Three understates this reset; five lacks evidence of exceptional ecosystem impact.
ratingReview.evidence: Finalized removal, queue and NetworkAdded events; Exact registration and owner state before and after
